title: Whykey Verified Baseline Identity Manifest
description: Recorded provenance for the pre-refactor reference baseline binary used by the differential comparator.
source_summary: fix: preserve diagnostic uncertainty and target routing

platform_scope.scope_limitation: This baseline binary hash and artifact are strictly limited to x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu built with the exact recorded Rust 1.98.1 toolchain. Cross-platform bit-for-bit identity is not claimed; runtime behavioral equivalence under controlled test suites is verified.

reconstruction_prerequisites.documentation: Reconstructing this baseline requires a Git repository checkout where commit fe52e3604ec028b39843f641c48500abe73c5a7e is reachable. A released source archive or snapshot lacking .git history does not contain historical commits and is insufficient for baseline reconstruction. To rebuild, use: tools/rebuild_baseline.sh --toolchain 1.98.1 fe52e36 target/baseline/whykey
